bone_colossus: A towering colossus built from hundreds of yellowed bones, with a broad ribcage, two thick arms made of stacked leg bones and a single huge skull with dark empty eye sockets lit by cold cyan-green ghostly light. He stands facing the viewer with both fists planted on the ground in front of him. Several smaller yellowed human skeletons with rusty scraps of armor are fused into his shoulders, and a single broken stone pillar stands behind him with pale dust rising from his feet.
rat_horde: Five grey rats with pink ears, pink tails and small red eyes run side by side toward us across bare ground, their heads low and their mouths open. Each rat has four legs planted mid-stride and one long pink tail trailing behind it. A round dark burrow hole in a mossy bank stands behind them, and a low cloud of dust rises from their paws.
rat_brute: Three large grey rats with pink ears, pink tails and small red eyes, each the size of a big dog, charge forward side by side with their heads low and their yellowed front teeth showing. The middle rat is slightly ahead of the other two, and all four paws of each rat touch the ground. A single broken wooden barrel lies on its side behind them, and pale dust kicks up from their paws.
boiling_oil: A lone human knight in dented steel plate armor with a faded blue tabard and a plain round steel helmet, holding a straight steel sword, dropping to both knees, seen from the side, his right gauntlet holding the sword point down on the ground and his left hand pressed against his shoulder. Dark glossy oil pours down over his helmet and shoulders from above, and thin steam rises from the oil and from the wet ground around him. A black iron cauldron tilts at the very top edge of the scene behind him.
bone_legion: Five yellowed human skeletons with dark empty eye sockets and rusty scraps of armor march forward side by side in a wide shallow line, each one holding one rusty short sword in his right hand and one round wooden shield on his left arm. Their jaws hang slightly open and their ribs show clearly. A single leaning gravestone stands behind them, and pale dust rises from their footsteps.
fire_imp: Three small fire imps with glowing orange-red skin, short black horns and thin pointed tails charge forward in a line across bare ground, each one leaning forward with both clawed hands reaching ahead. Small flames flicker along their shoulders and backs. A single charred tree stump stands behind them, and a few embers rise in the air behind the group.
bone_colossus_v2: A towering colossus made of a few huge smooth pale bones: one big round skull for a head with two large dark sockets lit by cold cyan-green ghostly light, a broad chest made of four thick curved ribs, and two massive arms each made of one thick leg bone. He stands facing the viewer with both big plain fists planted on the ground in front of him. A single broken stone pillar stands behind him and pale dust rises from his feet.
fire_imp_v2: Three small fire imps with glowing orange-red skin, short black horns and thin pointed tails charge forward in a line across bare ground, each one leaning forward with both clawed hands reaching ahead. Each imp has two clear narrow almond-shaped eyes of bright pale yellow on its face, easy to see against the red skin. Small flames flicker along their shoulders and backs. A single charred tree stump stands behind them, and a few embers rise in the air behind the group.
bone_colossus_v3: A gigantic human skeleton standing upright and facing the viewer, built exactly like a real human skeleton at giant size: one round skull with a jaw, a spine, one ribcage of simple curved ribs, a pelvis, two arms that each have one upper arm bone, two forearm bones and one open hand with five fingers, and two legs that each have one thigh bone, two shin bones and one foot. Both arms hang at its sides. Its two big dark skull sockets glow with cold cyan-green ghostly light. A single broken stone pillar stands behind it and pale dust rises from its feet.
fire_imp_v3: Three small fire imps with glowing orange-red skin, short black horns and thin pointed tails charge forward in a line across bare ground, each one leaning forward with both clawed hands reaching ahead. Each imp has two narrow almond-shaped eyes that are one flat solid bright yellow, easy to see against the red skin. Small flames flicker along their shoulders and backs. A single charred tree stump stands behind them, and a few embers rise in the air behind the group.
bone_colossus_v3_parado: A gigantic human skeleton seen from a low angle, so large that it fills the whole height of the picture, its skull near the top edge and its two feet at the bottom edge, standing upright and facing the viewer. It is built exactly like a real human skeleton with thick bones: one round skull with a jaw, a spine, one ribcage of simple curved ribs, a pelvis, two arms that each have one upper arm bone, two forearm bones and one open hand with five fingers, and two legs that each have one thigh bone, two shin bones and one foot. Both arms hang at its sides. Its two big dark skull sockets glow with cold cyan-green ghostly light. A single broken stone pillar stands beside one foot and pale dust rises around its feet.
bone_colossus_Y: A gigantic human skeleton seen from a low front angle, striding straight toward us with its right leg stepping forward and its left leg far behind, its right arm reaching out toward us with the open hand wide, its left arm swung back, its head lowered and its jaw open in a roar, its whole body leaning forward. Built exactly like a real human skeleton with thick bones: one round skull with a jaw, a spine, one ribcage of simple curved ribs, a pelvis, two arms that each have one upper arm bone, two forearm bones and one hand with five fingers, and two legs that each have one thigh bone, two shin bones and one foot. Its two big dark skull sockets glow with cold cyan-green ghostly light. A broken stone pillar lies toppled beside its foot and a cloud of pale dust rolls up around its legs.
bone_colossus_Y2b: A gigantic human skeleton with warm yellowed ivory bones like old aged bone, seen from a low front angle, striding straight toward us with its right leg stepping forward and its left leg far behind, its right arm reaching out toward us with the open hand wide, its left arm swung back, its head lowered and its jaw open in a roar, its whole body leaning forward. Built exactly like a real human skeleton with thick bones: one round skull with a jaw, a spine, one ribcage of simple curved ribs, a pelvis, two arms that each have one upper arm bone, two forearm bones and one hand with five fingers, and two legs that each have one thigh bone, two shin bones and one foot. Its two big dark skull sockets glow with cold cyan-green ghostly light. It strides through a broken graveyard: three large leaning gravestones and one toppled stone pillar lie around its feet, with big broken stone slabs and cracked earth between them, and a cloud of pale dust rolls up around its legs.
eternal_army_v1: Five yellowed human skeletons with rusty scraps of armor climb up out of the bare ground in one rough line, each holding one plain rusted sword in its right hand and its left arm hanging at its side. Cold cyan-green ghostly light pours up from the ground around their legs and washes over their bones. One cracked gravestone stands behind them and pale dust drifts up behind the line.
raised_servant_v1: A single yellowed human skeleton with dark empty eye sockets and rusty scraps of armor, hunched forward and running at the viewer in a low chase. His right bony hand reaches out ahead of him with the fingers spread, his left arm swings back at his side. Pale cyan-green ghostly light glows in his ribcage, and a single leaning gravestone stands behind him with thin wisps of cold smoke trailing from his heels.
soul_harvest_v1: A single yellowed human skeleton with dark empty eye sockets and rusty scraps of armor, standing upright with both arms hanging at its sides and its head tilted back. Four small pale wisps of cold cyan-green ghostly light rise from its ribcage and curl upward toward a hovering glowing orb above its skull. A leaning wooden grave marker stands behind it, and faint embers of light drift up behind its shoulders.
raised_servant_v2: A single yellowed human skeleton with dark empty eye sockets and rusty scraps of armor, hunched forward and running at the viewer in a low chase. His right bony hand reaches out ahead of him with the fingers spread, his left arm swings back at his side. His bones are painted in warm yellowed ivory, the same warm color as old aged bone, and his skull is a normal human size. A small pale cyan-green glow shines in the dark gap of his ribcage, and a single leaning gravestone stands behind him with thin wisps of cold smoke trailing from his heels.
soul_harvest_v2: A single yellowed human skeleton with dark empty eye sockets and rusty scraps of armor, standing upright with both arms hanging at its sides and its head tilted back. Its bones are painted in warm yellowed ivory, the same warm color as old aged bone. Four small pale wisps of cold cyan-green ghostly light rise from its ribcage and curl upward toward a hovering glowing orb above its skull. A leaning wooden grave marker stands behind it, and faint embers of light drift up behind its shoulders.
drakeling_v4: A small young red dragon with smooth crimson skin, a pale yellow belly and two short horns, hovering in the air with both wings spread wide and its neck stretched forward. It spits one bright ball of orange fire from its open mouth toward us. A single round rock spire rises far behind it, and a few orange embers trail behind its tail.
hell_hound_v4: A huge black hound the size of a horse with smooth charcoal fur, a broad muzzle and short rounded ears, bounding forward with all four legs stretched and its jaws open wide. Its back and shoulders glow with large patches of molten orange. A few streaks of orange fire trail from its paws across the bare ground, and thin smoke wisps drift up behind it.
ash_salamander_v4: A large stocky salamander with smooth charcoal-grey skin and broad glowing orange patches along its back, walking slowly forward on four thick short legs with its heavy tail curving to the left. Its wide flat head is lifted slightly. A wide ribbon of flames burns on the ground where it has stepped, and grey ash drifts up behind it.
